stories.title: DEMO: This is where a world headline will appear
stories.snippet: Demonstration card only, not real news. After the first scheduled update, real headlines from the sources in sources.json replace these.

stories.title: DEMO: Every card links back to the original publisher
stories.snippet: Buzz shows only a headline, a short snippet and a link. The full story always stays with the outlet that reported it.

stories.title: DEMO: Stories backed by one outlet carry a clear label
stories.snippet: Until the multi-source check arrives in a later stage, every story is marked as single source so nothing looks more verified than it is.

stories.title: DEMO: Science and discovery stories get their own scene
stories.snippet: Each topic has its own illustration. The final mascot and full set of scenes arrive in the design stage.

stories.title: DEMO: Plain-language explainers come in a later stage
stories.snippet: The Explain, Simplify and Listen buttons are not built yet. This first version shows real headlines, sources and links.
